description: This file defines a function 'drainFormattedSystemEvents' that processes system event logs, filters and formats them, and optionally adds a channel summary. It interacts with external modules for time formatting, system event retrieval, and configuration resolution.

methods.name: drainFormattedSystemEvents
methods.description: Asynchronously drains queued system events, filters and formats them as 'System:' lines, and optionally prepends a channel summary if it's a new main session.
